correctness.rationale: Exact regenerative first- and second-moment identity; uniform geometric excursion bounds; enumeration of all recovery-only paths yields positive cut-weighted coefficient. value.rationale: The first non-exponential second-moment correction makes the graph-topology-dependent accuracy of a common extinction-time approximation quantitative. In particular, a four-vertex star and path have equal leading mean coefficient R=8 yet distinct C=112/3 and 38, motivating the exact invariant in epidemiological network assessment.
